description: Java source code defining the Staff entity class for the Fineract project, including fields, relationships, and methods for staff management.

classes.name: Staff
classes.description: Entity class representing staff members within the organization, with fields for personal and organizational details, and methods for updating and managing staff data.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a Staff instance from JSON command input and associated office.

methods.name: organisationalRoleData
methods.description: Returns the organizational role data as an EnumOptionData object.

methods.name: changeOffice
methods.description: Updates the staff's office to a new office.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates staff details based on JSON command input, returning the changes made.

methods.name: isNotLoanOfficer
methods.description: Checks if the staff is not a loan officer.

methods.name: isLoanOfficer
methods.description: Checks if the staff is a loan officer.

methods.name: isNotActive
methods.description: Checks if the staff is not active.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the staff is active.

methods.name: deriveDisplayName
methods.description: Generates display name based on first and last name.

methods.name: identifiedBy
methods.description: Determines if this staff is identified by another staff's ID.

methods.name: emailAddress
methods.description: Returns the email address of the staff.

methods.name: officeId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the staff's office.

methods.name: displayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the staff.

methods.name: mobileNo
methods.description: Returns the mobile number of the staff.

methods.name: office
methods.description: Returns the Office object associated with the staff.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the image for the staff member.
